lore.summary: Steven presents the inaugural SoCal Retro Gaming Expo as collector-designed and collector-organized; this is his event-positioning claim, not verified regional firstness.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Announced January30–31,2016, City of Industry,9–5 both days; all competitions/admission free per closing. These are historical plans, not current event information.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Johnny prefers clean ready-to-play games and dislikes restoring dirty trade stock, even needing to clean his nails after handling it.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven promises an organized professional environment but explicitly cannot control what every vendor brings.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: I can’t really control what they bring

lore.summary: Steven holds retail to a higher standard: clean/test merchandise and let customers go home and play it immediately.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: We clean them, we test them

lore.summary: Expo activities include free-play arcades, a history museum, Star Fox competition reproductions and a professional Smash tournament, not merely sales tables.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Star Fox competition carts to be sold are explicitly reproductions; the $800 comparison is a dated original-price claim, not an actual purchase or current valuation.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Kat's 'Your favorite, Johnny' and his 'big fan' reproduction exchange is teasing; no sincere pro-reproduction policy established.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven wants an experience with actual retro-game booths and play, avoiding events dominated by ancillary shirts/perlers. Johnny agrees games are his draw.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: more than just video games on tables

lore.summary: Steven pursues a complete SNES collection and reports trying every game acquired, discovering unknown games along the way.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven recalls winning a $2000 Toys R Us sweepstakes at agefive in1985 through a Showbiz Pizza contest entered by his mother; it enabled Atari2600/NES and toys.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven says he retained childhood packaging and even handwritten Dracula X codes by himself and his sister; condition is his rough7/10 judgment.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: my sister has her codes too

lore.summary: A layoff after his daughter's birth helped prompt self-employment thinking; he had accumulated duplicate inventory while shopping online/swap meets around2003/2004.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: After seven months at a better-paying new job, Steven gave30days notice and began vending the following Saturday; chronology remains his recollection.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: working seven months in this new company

lore.summary: Frank & Son is described as 'Costco for nerds,' a mixed collectibles warehouse rather than exclusively a game shop; raw venue-name transcription varies.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven says he initially underpriced to build long-term customers and wanted a knowledgeable, fair, professional game retail experience.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Interview describes Wednesday and Saturday venue hours and sports/autograph traffic; do not treat these2016details as current opening hours.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: Wednesdays from like three to nine

lore.summary: Kat says she cannot skate, but denies being the only Canadian who cannot; Johnny's national-generalization joke is not a demographic fact.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven clarifies booth opening as June2008 after a loose six/eight-year discussion; retain exact stated date rather than inferred start year.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Johnny values clean, well-cared-for stock and knowledgeable service, even if it costs a few dollars more; this is personal preference, not endorsement verification.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Johnny and Steven recall growth around2007/2010/2012 and wider N64/PS1/Dreamcast-era interest; these are dated qualitative memories, not market statistics.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven describes keeping multiple booths after accepting a better location, then opening a separate store in April the prior year; he regrets not doing so sooner.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven chose Diamond Bar after a year of research, abouttenminutes from Frank & Son, and describes long workdays while also organizing the expo.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Store is Super Video Game Bros. At recording, online stock categories were SNES/NES/PS1/Genesis and rapid sell-through made website inventory hard to maintain.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: Super Nintendo, Nintendo and PS1 and Sega Genesis

lore.summary: Website can be a price guide but calling may find unposted stock; inventory availability is not guaranteed. April anniversary had not yet occurred.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: sells before you have the time to take a picture

lore.summary: Travel costs to Vegas/Portland conventions and many local collectors motivated a Southern California event; venue partnership made it feasible.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven partnered with Frank & Son's owner and others, taking an industry-knowledge/connection leadership role. No sole-founder claim.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: we partnered up with a few more people

lore.summary: Steven contrasts estimated major-center rental costs with their partnership, says admission free and expects roughly break-even; not audited finances.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: I think we’re just breaking even

lore.summary: Steven does not know exact floor area, gives approximate70spaces/50uniquevendors and10x10 or6x10booths, pointing to a vendor map.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: As far as specs, I’m sorry. It’s not my division and I don’t know

lore.summary: Confirmed announced guests: Pat the NES Punk, Gamester81, Keith Robinson/Blue Sky Rangers. Later says talent will have panels as well as booths; sponsor hopes remain undisclosed.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: confirmation from Pat the NES Punk

lore.summary: Steven's main collection is SNES with a soft spot for NES; expanding into TurboGrafx/PC Engine/Genesis. His favorites answer names Mega Man X series, Chrono Trigger and Super Metroid despite NES wording in prompt.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: Mega Man X series is top number one

lore.summary: Steven chooses Super Metroid over Turtles in Time; the exchange includes beat-em-up praise and Johnny's personal Super Metroid affection, not objective universal ranking.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: personal deep affection for Super Metroid

lore.summary: Johnny plans to attend and send Kat updates while she stays in Canada. Flying her over next year is a wish, not booked travel.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: I’m going to be stuck in Canada

lore.summary: Steven beat Phantom Pain last week and is still thinking about it; he also plays Alien Crush and reports26million versus a friend's3million.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: Then I sat down to like 26 million

lore.summary: Kat has Super Mario RPG for the third time and intends to keep this copy; play-start language shifts between getting into it and going to start.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: This is the third time I’ve had it

lore.summary: Johnny uses short virtual-pinball sessions because he lacks mental space for story-heavy play like Fallout; unnamed virtual pins are not silently equated with a previous episode's software.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: I have like 20 minutes to game

lore.summary: Alien Crush five-copy teasing is corrected by Johnny to three, with some variants; do not invent three edition identities.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Steven's complete/all-inserts Dark Water cost125; GunForce joins it as SNEScollection486/487. This is personal collection, not reseller inventory.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

lore.summary: Kat's reacquired Super Mario RPG is CIB, not pristine, but a good deal; no numeric price supplied.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: Not pristine, but I also get it for a really great deal

lore.summary: Johnny already had the Eye of the Beholder cartridge and added box/manual; Kirby Wii purchase is compared with his rough100gamesat$2spree.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: I had a cart, but I finally found the box in the manual

lore.summary: Johnny likens buying bad Wii games to watching bad movies, cites Hotel for Dogs/pet-vet/uncertain McCarthy game, and only conditionally mentions a complete Wii set.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: if I ever decide to complete the Wii set

lore.summary: Johnny wants to share his collection, including Instagram; a walk-through museum is a fanciful possibility, not an announced operating museum. Steven recalls seeing the collection around2011.

speaker.basis: Interview turn prompts and contextual continuity; not audio.

evidence.quote: I personally saw your collection. I think it was in 2011
